integrity: One continuous analytic proof; numerical matrix tests are corroborative only. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: All observations lie on one radius and sample full complex amplitudes; positivity and unit total weight are imposed. Published equispaced-circle coherent-state eigenvalues are credited, and historical priority of general weighted design rigidity remains provisional. Numerical checks do not prove the infinite claim.
title: Sharp one-circle sampling barrier and design rigidity for truncated Bargmann–Fock spaces
